run-record-fields.text: As a reviewer, I want each run record to carry every identity the two runs must share or differ on, so their comparison is mechanical.

run-record.text: One JSON object per run, mutant.json and restored.json. Every field is read from the environment or the command's output, never typed.

pair-invariants.text: A pair is admissible only when both records exist, share lean, blueprint, genesis, node, command and env, and satisfy their own exit and witness rules. A missing witness, a setup failure or any other cause of a nonzero mutant exit makes the pair inadmissible, and the record says so.
